Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode? - 3-Player Co-op: No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required. - 3 Game Modes: - Campaign: 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty. - Endless: Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder. - Custom: Players create their own challenge by adjusting bomb difficulty, the timer, module types, environmental hazards, and how many mistakes are allowed. - Asymmetric Roles: Every player sees, hears, and acts differently. - Fun interactions: Point, wave, gesture or flail wildly. Your options are only limited by your imagination and each player's Emote wheel. - Slapping: Obviously an essential feature. - New Environments: We all know the trusty minivan, but what about a plane? What other environments can you defuse bombs in? - Environmental Hazards: Navigate events like power outages, obstructions and loud interruptions. - Voice Chat: Some of you can talk, some of you can’t. You’ll figure it out. - Puzzle Modules: Each bomb has different modules and different rules, all of which are guaranteed to induce different kinds of panic. - Level System: Defuse the bomb to unlock new levels. The better you get, the harder they are. - Color Blind Mode: Just because the monkey is blind, doesn’t mean he can’t defuse a bomb! Colors used across objects and the UI have been adapted to support two different types of color blindness. Praised worldwide for its narrative, game design, and combat system, Metaphor: ReFantazio is an RPG masterpiece. With a Metascore of 94 and over 50 prestigious awards, including 'Best RPG' at The Game Awards 2024, the next evolution of fantasy RPG is here on Nintendo Switch™ 2!Enter the royal tournament to fight for the throne and for the future. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical “Archetype” powers that lie dormant in your heart. Team up with a compelling cast of characters and embark on an immersive journey that promises hours of captivating exploration, dynamic turn-based with a blend of real-time combat, and exhilarating discovery.Key Features:-Fantasy RPG: A mysterious & exciting story unfolds in a world where people must fight their own anxiety. Join the high-stakes Royal Tournament that promises hours of captivating exploration and discovery. -Award-winning Art Direction: Ride your “gauntlet runner” to faraway dungeons & towns across an expansive world. Discover beautiful landscapes accompanied by captivating music, immersive UI, ＆ anime cutscenes.-Innovative Battle System: An exhilarating turn-based combat system with a blend of real time action. Party customization through "Archetype" powers provides the freedom to personalize your adventures. -Time Management System: Go on quests, dungeon dive, & hunt for treasures by day. Strengthen relationships, build bonds, & increase virtues by night. Choose your actions wisely, time management is key to achieving your goal. Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Pre-order now to unlock exclusive in-game consumable item sets, designed to aid you on your epic adventure wherever your journey takes you.■Product Details ・Metaphor: ReFantazio Archetype EXP Chest Set ・Metaphor: ReFantazio Adventurer’s Journey Pack■Set Details Archetype EXP Chest Set・10x Hero's Incenses (Increases Archetype Experiences by 100)・5x Hero's Fruits (Increases Archetype Experiences by 500)Adventurer’s Journey Pack・30,000 Reeve (In-game currency)・5x Expensive Medicines (Restores 200 HP to one ally)・5x Revival Medicines (Revives an ally)・3x Magical Breads (Gradually recover MP while in dungeon)・2x Stale Blackbreads (Deals 300 Almighty damage to one enemy)*After downloading this DLC, you can receive it at the in-game facility "Akademeia."*Available for purchase until November 11, 2026 (Wednesday) at 8:59 PM (PT).Related tagsRole playingChoose your difficultyRaise your statsVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)62.1 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedAccessibility featuresSurround SoundDifficulty LevelsPlayable without Motion ControlsPlayable without Rapid Button PressesPlayable without Touch ControlsLearn more about the Accessible Games Initiative’s tag descriptions.Nintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
